manim.animation.animation.Animation.note: Base Animation defaults: introducer=False, remover=False, suspend_mobject_updating=True; begin() copies the starting mobject, clean_up_from_scene removes the target only when remover (animation.py Animation.__init__/begin/clean_up_from_scene).

manim.animation.animation.Wait.note: stop_condition together with frozen_frame=True raises at construction; frozen_frame=None lets the Scene decide static vs dynamic (animation.py Wait.__init__, scene.py should_update_mobjects).

manim.animation.changing.TracedPath.note: Registers an updater on itself that calls traced_point_func every frame; with dissipating_time=None the path grows O(frames) (changing.py TracedPath).

manim.animation.composition.AnimationGro.note: Plays member animations together; group-level introducer/remover facts depend on the members. An empty group is a runtime error (MLC109).

manim.animation.composition.LaggedStart.note: AnimationGroup whose members start staggered by lag_ratio; stagger belongs to the group constructor, not to play kwargs (composition.py LaggedStart).

manim.animation.composition.Succession.note: Plays member animations strictly one after another (composition.py Succession).

manim.animation.creation.Create.note: Incrementally shows a VMobject; constructor default introducer=True adds the target during play setup (creation.py Create.__init__).

manim.animation.creation.DrawBorderThenF.note: TypeErrors on non-vectorized mobjects; default introducer=True (creation.py DrawBorderThenFill.__init__/_typecheck_input).

manim.animation.creation.ShowPartial.note: Abstract base for partial-show animations; raises TypeError unless the target has pointwise_become_partial (creation.py ShowPartial.__init__).

manim.animation.creation.Uncreate.note: Create in reverse; default remover=True removes the target during play cleanup (creation.py Uncreate.__init__).

manim.animation.creation.Unwrite.note: Write with reverse=True by default, which makes it a remover and not an introducer (creation.py Unwrite.__init__, Write.__init__).

manim.animation.creation.Write.note: Defaults shown are for reverse=False; Write(..., reverse=True) becomes remover=True and introducer=False (creation.py Write.__init__).

manim.animation.fading.FadeIn.note: Passes introducer=True; the target is added during play setup, not at construction (fading.py FadeIn.__init__).

manim.animation.fading.FadeOut.note: Passes remover=True; a target not yet in the Scene is still auto-added at play begin and removed at cleanup (fading.py FadeOut.__init__, scene.py add_mobjects_from_animations).

manim.animation.growing.GrowFromCenter.note: GrowFromPoint with the target's center as the growth point (growing.py GrowFromCenter).

manim.animation.rotation.Rotate.note: Transform that rotates the live mobject about a point or edge (rotation.py Rotate).

manim.animation.transform.ApplyFunction.note: create_target() calls function(mobject.copy()) and raises TypeError unless the function returns a Mobject (transform.py ApplyFunction.create_target).

manim.animation.transform.ApplyMethod.note: Takes an un-called bound mobject method plus its arguments; passing the result of calling the method is a runtime error (transform.py ApplyMethod).

manim.animation.transform.CyclicReplace.note: Wraps its *mobjects into a Group and plays the group, so the positional arguments are family members, not scene roots; bases intentionally uncurated so Transform chain facts are not inherited (transform.py CyclicReplace.__init__).

manim.animation.transform.FadeTransform.note: clean_up_from_scene diverges from Transform: it removes the played group and adds the target at the end of the display list (transform.py FadeTransform.clean_up_from_scene); bases intentionally uncurated so Transform cleanup facts are not inherited.

manim.animation.transform.MoveToTarget.note: Raises ValueError unless mobject.generate_target() populated mobject.target first (transform.py MoveToTarget.check_validity_of_input).

manim.animation.transform.ReplacementTra.note: Transform with replace_mobject_with_target_in_scene=True: cleanup swaps the source for the target in the Scene root list (transform.py ReplacementTransform.__init__, Transform.clean_up_from_scene).

manim.animation.transform.Restore.note: ApplyMethod over mobject.restore; requires a prior save_state() on every path (transform.py Restore, mobject.py Mobject.restore).

manim.animation.transform.Swap.note: Alias of CyclicReplace for two mobjects (transform.py Swap).

manim.animation.transform.Transform.note: The live source mobject takes the target's shape; the target copy is not added to the Scene (transform.py Transform.begin/clean_up_from_scene, DESIGN 3.2).

manim.animation.transform.TransformFromC.note: The constructor swaps its arguments (super().__init__(target_mobject, mobject)), so the first positional argument is not the played mobject; bases intentionally uncurated so Animation auto-add facts are not inherited (transform.py TransformFromCopy.__init__).

manim.animation.transform_matching_parts.note: clean_up_from_scene removes the source mobject and internal fade copies, then adds the target (transform_matching_parts.py clean_up_from_scene).
Matches submobject shapes by normalized point hash; net Scene effect replaces the source with the target (transform_matching_parts.py TransformMatchingShapes).
Matches submobjects by tex_string; net Scene effect replaces the source with the target (transform_matching_parts.py TransformMatchingTex).

manim.animation.updaters.mobject_update_.note: Calls the factory once immediately and re-runs it every frame via an attached updater; the factory body is a hot context (mobject_update_utils.py always_redraw).

manim.animation.updaters.update.UpdateFr.note: Calls update_function(mobject, rate_func(alpha)) every frame (update.py UpdateFromAlphaFunc.interpolate_mobject).
Calls update_function(mobject) every frame; suspend_mobject_updating defaults to False here (update.py UpdateFromFunc.__init__).

manim.camera.moving_camera.MovingCamera.note: Camera with an animatable frame used by MovingCameraScene (moving_camera.py MovingCamera).

manim.camera.three_d_camera.ThreeDCamera.note: Cairo 3D camera holding phi/theta/zoom trackers and fixed-object registries (three_d_camera.py ThreeDCamera).

manim.constants.CapStyleType.note: Enum class of cap styles (constants.py CapStyleType).

manim.constants.DEGREES.note: TAU / 360; multiply degree literals by this scalar.

manim.constants.LineJointType.note: Enum class of line joint styles (constants.py LineJointType).

manim.constants.RendererType.note: Enum class of renderer names, values "cairo" / "opengl" (constants.py RendererType).

manim.constants.X_AXIS.note: Unit vector (1, 0, 0) as a rotation axis.

manim.constants.Y_AXIS.note: Unit vector (0, 1, 0) as a rotation axis.

manim.constants.Z_AXIS.note: Unit vector (0, 0, 1) as a rotation axis.

manim.mobject.geometry.arc.TipableVMobje.note: Structural ancestor for arcs and lines that can carry tips.

manim.mobject.graphing.coordinate_system.note: VGroup + CoordinateSystem; plot/axis helpers construct new VMobjects (coordinate_systems.py Axes).
Defined on CoordinateSystem; returns a new ParametricFunction sampled from `function`, never the axes (coordinate_systems.py CoordinateSystem.plot, MLP221).

manim.mobject.graphing.functions.Paramet.note: Samples `function` over t_range at construction; the callable runs per generate_points call, not per frame (graphing/functions.py ParametricFunction, MLP221).

manim.mobject.mobject.Group.note: Container that accepts heterogeneous Mobject children; use it instead of VGroup when mixing non-vectorized members (mobject.py Group).

manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.note: Root display object. A bare Mobject() has no drawable points; adding one as a visible leaf shows nothing (MLR125).

manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.add.note: Ignores duplicate children with a warning and rejects direct self-addition (mobject.py Mobject.add).

manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.add_update.note: Manim calls the callback as (mobject, dt) only when a parameter literally named dt exists; otherwise as (mobject). A dt parameter also makes plain wait() dynamic (mobject.py Mobject.add_updater, DESIGN 3.3).

manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.become.note: Rewrites points, style, and submobjects in place to match another mobject; identity is preserved (mobject.py Mobject.become).

manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.copy.note: Returns a new deepcopy with a fresh identity; the clone is not in the Scene even if the original was (mobject.py Mobject.copy).

manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.family_mem.note: Returns the list of family members with points, never self (mobject.py Mobject.family_members_with_points).

manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.generate_t.note: Stores a copy in mobject.target and returns that copy, not self (mobject.py Mobject.generate_target).

manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.get_all_po.note: Returns the merged points array of the family, never self (mobject.py Mobject.get_all_points).

manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.get_family.note: Returns the flattened family list, never self (mobject.py Mobject.get_family).

manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.remove.note: Structural removal from this mobject's submobjects (contrast Scene.remove, which edits only the Scene root list).

manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.remove_upd.note: Matches the callback by function identity; passing a fresh lambda removes nothing (mobject.py Mobject.remove_updater, MLC125).

manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.restore.note: Raises unless save_state() ran first; becomes the saved copy in place (mobject.py Mobject.restore).

manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.save_state.note: Stores a copy in mobject.saved_state and returns self (mobject.py Mobject.save_state).

manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.set_z_inde.note: Preferred over shift(OUT)/set_z for 2D Cairo stacking order (MLR121).

manim.mobject.svg.svg_mobject.SVGMobject.note: Construction parses the SVG XML and builds the point family; it is not a plain file read (svg_mobject.py, DESIGN 4.3).

manim.mobject.text.numbers.DecimalNumber.note: Construct once and drive with set_value in an updater instead of rebuilding Text/MathTex per frame (MLP201 guidance).

manim.mobject.text.tex_mobject.MathTex.note: Cache miss runs an external TeX compiler and dvisvgm; distinct formulas are distinct compile jobs (tex_mobject.py, utils/tex_file_writing.py).

manim.mobject.text.text_mobject.MarkupTe.note: Interprets Pango markup; construction includes shaping and SVG generation (text_mobject.py MarkupText).

manim.mobject.text.text_mobject.Text.note: Construction includes shaping, SVG generation/parsing, and glyph family build; markup tags are not interpreted (text_mobject.py Text, MLR124).

manim.mobject.text.text_mobject.register.note: @contextmanager generator: the font registers on __enter__ and unregisters on __exit__, so a bare call has no effect (text_mobject.py register_font, MLR117). Star-exported via text_mobject.__all__.

manim.mobject.three_d.three_dimensions.S.note: Face count drives per-frame sort/projection/raster cost under Cairo (three_dimensions.py Surface, DESIGN 4.3).

manim.mobject.types.image_mobject.Abstra.note: Structural ancestor of ImageMobject; not vectorized.

manim.mobject.types.image_mobject.ImageM.note: Raster image; not a VMobject, so Create/Write reject it and VGroup membership is invalid (image_mobject.py ImageMobject).

manim.mobject.types.vectorized_mobject.V.note: Accepts only vectorized children; mixing in a plain Mobject (e.g. ImageMobject) is a runtime error — use Group (vectorized_mobject.py VGroup, MLC126).

renderer.note: Point storage is renderer-specific: Cairo stores cubic Bezier curves as 4 points per curve, OpenGL quadratic as 3 points per curve; raw .points access that assumes one layout is not portable (DESIGN 3.6).

manim.mobject.types.vectorized_mobject.V.note: Returns the sampled arc length as a float, never self (vectorized_mobject.py VMobject.get_arc_length).
Subdivides curves in place and returns self; part of the align cost surface (vectorized_mobject.py VMobject.insert_n_curves, DESIGN 14).

manim.mobject.value_tracker.ValueTracker.note: Invisible value holder; animate it or read it from updaters (value_tracker.py ValueTracker).
Returns the tracked float, not the mobject.

renderer.note: The MovingCamera frame contract targets the Cairo renderer in 0.20; OpenGL paths through self.camera.frame are incompatible (moving_camera_scene.py, MLR119).

manim.scene.scene.Scene.note: render() runs setup -> construct -> tear_down in order; base setup/tear_down are empty (scene.py Scene.render, DESIGN 3.1).

manim.scene.scene.Scene.add.note: Not a set insert: an already-present mobject is removed and re-appended, changing draw order; submobjects display via the family (scene.py Scene.add, DESIGN 3.4).

manim.scene.scene.Scene.add_foreground_m.note: Also calls Scene.add; foreground objects widen the Cairo moving scope (scene.py Scene.add_foreground_mobject).

manim.scene.scene.Scene.add_updater.note: Scene updaters always receive exactly (dt), run last each frame, and make plain wait() dynamic; under Cairo they do not mark the mobjects they mutate as moving (scene.py Scene.add_updater, MLR111).

manim.scene.scene.Scene.bring_to_front.note: Re-adds at the end of the root list; a lower z_index still sorts the mobject behind others in the effective display order (scene.py Scene.bring_to_front, MLR122).

manim.scene.scene.Scene.clear.note: Empties both mobjects and foreground_mobjects (scene.py Scene.clear).

manim.scene.scene.Scene.play.note: Compiles arguments to Animations (mob.animate builders included; other values TypeError), auto-adds non-introducer targets before begin, and applies introducer/remover/replacement effects at setup/cleanup (scene.py Scene.play/play_internal, DESIGN 3.2).

manim.scene.scene.Scene.remove.note: Restructures the Scene root list only; parents' submobjects are untouched, so re-adding or animating the old parent makes the child reappear (scene.py Scene.remove/restructure_mobjects, MLC115).

manim.scene.scene.Scene.remove_foregroun.note: Only unregisters foreground status; the mobject stays in the Scene (scene.py Scene.remove_foreground_mobject).
Only unregisters foreground status; the mobjects stay in the Scene (scene.py Scene.remove_foreground_mobjects).

manim.scene.scene.Scene.remove_updater.note: Matches the callback by function identity (scene.py Scene.remove_updater).

manim.scene.scene.Scene.replace.note: old_mobject must be present (directly or inside a parent) and new_mobject must not already be in the Scene; draw order is preserved (scene.py Scene.replace, MLC119).

manim.scene.scene.Scene.wait.note: Plays Wait; with frozen_frame=None the frame freezes unless always_update_mobjects, a Scene updater, a stop_condition, or a time-based family updater exists (scene.py Scene.wait/should_update_mobjects, DESIGN 3.3).

manim.scene.three_d_scene.ThreeDScene.ad.note: Automatically adds the mobjects to the Scene and registers them as fixed-in-frame overlays (three_d_scene.py add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects).
Automatically adds the mobjects to the Scene and fixes their orientation relative to the camera (three_d_scene.py add_fixed_orientation_mobjects).

manim.scene.three_d_scene.ThreeDScene.be.note: Registers an ambient camera updater; camera motion can make the whole Scene moving (three_d_scene.py begin_ambient_camera_rotation).

manim.scene.three_d_scene.ThreeDScene.mo.note: Animates camera value trackers over a play (three_d_scene.py move_camera).

manim.scene.three_d_scene.ThreeDScene.re.note: Cairo only unregisters the camera fixation and the mobject stays displayed; the OpenGL branch also calls Scene.remove (three_d_scene.py remove_fixed_in_frame_mobjects, MLR108).
Cairo only unregisters the camera fixation; the OpenGL branch also calls Scene.remove (three_d_scene.py remove_fixed_orientation_mobjects, MLR108).

manim.utils.color.core.ManimColor.note: Internal color type; constructors and to_*/from_* converters return colors, never mobjects (color/core.py ManimColor).
